quotations.old_english: Ic ðé on ða fægran foldan gesette to neótenne neorxna wonges blǽdwélan
quotations.english: I set thee on the fair earth to enjoy the fruitful riches of Paradise

source_text: blǽd-wéla, an; m. Fruitful riches; opes uberes :-- Ic ðé on ða fægran foldan gesette to neótenne neorxna wonges blǽdwélan I set thee on the fair earth to enjoy the fruitful riches of Paradise, Exon. 28 a; Th. 85, 16; Cri. 1392.
